name: Your Best Rakugaki
source:
Spend 28 days with a doodle on your notebook.

Her name is "R." She is a doodle or "rakugaki" on your notebook who unconditionally loves you.
 
You can choose to keep talking to her, or ERASE her.

As the day progresses, you might be able to see a change in "R" herself too......

[From [url=https://asterisksrn.itch.io/your-best-rakugaki]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
与笔记本上的涂鸦少女共度28天吧。

她的名字叫“R”，是你画在笔记本上的一幅涂鸦（落书），毫无保留、无条件地深爱着你。

你可以选择继续陪她聊天，也可以选择将她彻底“擦除”。

随着日子一天天过去，你或许还会亲眼见证“R”自身悄然发生的变化……

[摘自[url=https://asterisksrn.itch.io/your-best-rakugaki]itch.io[/url]]
